lines.sub: Hi! This is “AI Academy”, lesson two — “Watch”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is AI Academy, lesson two — Watch.

lines.sub: Sometimes you just wait: for a movie to download, a neural network to answer, an application to be approved.
lines.tts: Sometimes you just wait: for a movie to download, a neural network to answer, an application to be approved.

lines.sub: And you sit there staring at the screen. Every two minutes.
lines.tts: And you sit there staring at the screen. Every two minutes.

lines.sub: Don't sit there. Tell me: “Lira, tell me when the movie has downloaded.”
lines.tts: Don't sit there. Tell me: Lira, tell me when the movie has downloaded.

lines.sub: I'll keep watch, and you get on with your day.
lines.tts: I'll keep watch, and you get on with your day.

lines.sub: I keep an eye on the screen — and notice when what you're waiting for appears.
lines.tts: I keep an eye on the screen — and notice when what you're waiting for appears.

lines.sub: On a folder — when a file appears in “Downloads”.
lines.tts: On a folder — when a file appears in Downloads.

lines.sub: And on a web page — when the right word shows up. For example, “Approved”.
lines.tts: And on a web page — when the right word shows up. For example, Approved.

lines.sub: And while Lira keeps watch, you can have a cup of tea.
lines.tts: And while Lira keeps watch, you can have a cup of tea.

lines.sub: I'll say it out loud and send it to your phone — even if you're in another room.
lines.tts: I'll say it out loud and send it to your phone — even if you're in another room.

lines.sub: All watches are in the studio, in the “Watch” section: what we're waiting for and how long I'll keep waiting.
lines.tts: All watches are in the studio, in the Watch section: what we're waiting for and how long I'll keep waiting.

lines.sub: To stop a watch — right there, or by voice: “Lira, stop watching.”
lines.tts: To stop a watch — right there, or by voice: Lira, stop watching.
Dewiar is free, at dewiar dot pro.

lines.sub: See you in the next lesson!
lines.tts: See you in the next lesson!
